title: Character under coordinate restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S,J\subseteq[n]$, and let $x\in\{0,1\}^n$. For uniform $y\in\{0,1\}^n$, form the point equal to $x$ on $J$ and to $y$ outside $J$. The expectation of its Walsh character indexed by $S$ is $\chi_S(x)$ if $S\subseteq J$, and is $0$ otherwise.
replaced: Let $S,J\subseteq[n]$ and $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, and let $x\star_J y$ equal $x$ on $J$ and $y$ elsewhere. Then for uniform $y$, $\mathbb E_y\chi_S(x\star_J y)=\chi_S(x)$ if $S\subseteq J$, and zero otherwise.
